review.reviewer: Claude Code (Achmage Presentation remake session) with instructor feedback on 2026-11-09
review.claims: All 77 slides keep the 2024 wording and order of the week-5 slides 5W-1 and 5W-2 with the instructor-approved typo and title fixes; the R results are the actual output of running the slide code in R 4.3.3. On instructor request the two decks are merged, the exercise titles read AI & R Exercise, the assignment slide is removed and one slide links the web version of the candy simulator. No new factual claims are added beyond describing that simulator.
review.images: Two Achmage Pele concept diagrams, R plots and re-typeset formulas (light and dark variants), screenshots and photographs or illustrations from the 2024 course slides, whose original sources are not recorded there, and a capture of the web candy simulator. Diagram descriptions are also given as body text.
review.links: External links named on the slides: the RStudio and R download pages, a Statistics Korea index page, two Posit Cloud projects and the web candy simulator. Their response status is recorded separately.
